after.doc: Effects executed after an option has been chosen, without repeating them in every option.

desc.doc: Localisation key or trigger-conditional desc block for the event description.

fire_only_once.doc: If yes, after this event fires it will never fire again for any country, even when triggered directly in code.

goto.doc:

hidden.doc: If yes, the event runs in the background without popping up for the player.

id.doc: Unique non-negative integer event id; must not be replicated in any other event file.

immediate.doc: Effects executed immediately on the event firing, before any option is chosen.

major_trigger.doc: Only displays the event to country validating the trigger

monarch_on_shipwreck.doc: ROOT is the country whose monarch was lost in the shipwreck.

on_abandon_colony.doc: ROOT is the colony province; FROM is the country abandoning it. This action fires before the colony is abandoned.

on_accept_tribute.doc: ROOT is the country receiving tribute; FROM is its overlord.

on_add_pasha.doc: THIS/ROOT is one province in the state receiving the pasha.

on_added_to_trade_company.doc: ROOT is the province added to a trade company; FROM is the country doing it.

on_adm_advisor_hired.doc: This action executes after on_advisor_hired for an ADM advisor.

on_adm_development.doc: ROOT is the province where administrative development changed.

on_adm_exploited.doc: ROOT is the province whose administrative development was exploited.

on_adm_tech_taken.doc: This action executes after on_tech_taken for an ADM technology.

on_admiral_recruited.doc: ROOT is the country recruiting the admiral.

on_advisor_hired.doc: ROOT is the country hiring the advisor.

on_alliance_broken.doc: ROOT is the original alliance creator; FROM is the alliance accepter.

on_alliance_created.doc: ROOT is the alliance sender; FROM is the alliance accepter.

on_annexed.doc: ROOT is the annexed nation; FROM is the nation performing the annexation.

on_bankruptcy.doc: ROOT is the country entering bankruptcy.

on_barrage.doc: ROOT is the country performing the barrage; FROM is the province being barraged.

on_battle_lost_country.doc: ROOT is the losing country; FROM is the winning country.

on_battle_lost_province.doc: ROOT is the battle location; FROM is the winning country.

on_battle_lost_unit.doc: This is the unit-scope on_action for a lost battle.

on_battle_won_country.doc: ROOT is the winning country; FROM is the losing country.

on_battle_won_province.doc: ROOT is the battle location; FROM is the losing country.

on_battle_won_unit.doc: This is the unit-scope on_action for a won battle.

on_capital_moved.doc: ROOT is the new capital province; FROM is the old capital province.

on_centralized_state.doc: ROOT is the province that was centralized.

on_change_revolution_target.doc: THIS is the new revolution target; FROM is the previous target. Either tag may be absent.

on_chinese_empire_dismantled.doc: ROOT is the current nation; FROM is the former Emperor when the Chinese Empire is dismantled.

on_colonial_liberation.doc: ROOT is the country involved in colonial liberation.

on_colonial_nation_established.doc: ROOT is the new colonial nation; FROM is its parent country.

on_colonial_reintegration.doc: ROOT is the country involved in colonial reintegration.

on_colonial_type_change.doc: ROOT is the colony; FROM is its overlord.

on_colonist_boosting_colony.doc: ROOT/THIS is the colony province; FROM is the owner country or a source province for minority expulsion.

on_colony_established.doc: ROOT/THIS is the newly created colony province; FROM is normally its owner country or a source province for minority expulsion.

on_colony_finished.doc: ROOT is the province where the colony finished.

on_company_chartered.doc: ROOT is the trade-company province; FROM is the previous country.

on_company_disolved.doc: ROOT is the trade-company province; FROM is the country performing the change.

on_company_formed.doc: ROOT is the trade-company province; FROM is the country forming the company.

on_conquest.doc: ROOT is the province taken by a new owner; FROM is the previous owner. The action fires when the takeover occurs.

on_conquistador_recruited.doc: ROOT is the country recruiting the conquistador.

on_consecrate_patriarch.doc: ROOT is the province being consecrated.

on_convert_by_trade_policy.doc: THIS/ROOT is the province; FROM is the country propagating the conversion through its trade policy.

on_core.doc: ROOT is the province receiving a core; FROM is the country receiving that core.

on_country_released.doc: THIS/ROOT is the released country; FROM is the country releasing it.

on_create_client_state.doc: THIS/ROOT is the new client state; FROM is its parent country.

on_create_vassal.doc: ROOT is the new vassal; FROM is its overlord.

on_death_election.doc: ROOT is the country where a ruler's death triggers an election.

on_death_foreign_slave_ruler.doc: ROOT is the country whose foreign slave ruler died.

on_defender_of_faith_loss.doc: ROOT is the country losing Defender of the Faith status.

on_dependency_gained.doc: ROOT is the overlord; FROM is the minor country gaining the dependency.

on_dependency_lost.doc: ROOT is the overlord; FROM is the minor country losing the dependency.

on_dip_advisor_hired.doc: This action executes after on_advisor_hired for a DIP advisor.

on_dip_development.doc: ROOT is the province where diplomatic development changed.

on_dip_tech_taken.doc: This action executes after on_tech_taken for a DIP technology.

on_diplomatic_annex.doc: The action runs in the annexing country; ROOT identifies the annexation target.

on_dismantle_revolution.doc: THIS is the revolutionary country being defeated; FROM is the country enforcing the peace treaty.

on_emperor_elected.doc: ROOT is the newly elected Emperor; FROM is the previous Emperor.

on_enforce_rebel_demands.doc: This action fires when rebel demands are enforced through a Support Rebels war.

on_expanded_infrastructure.doc: ROOT is the province whose infrastructure was expanded; FROM is the country doing it.

on_explore_coast.doc: ROOT is the discovered province; FROM is the country performing the exploration.

on_explorer_recruited.doc: ROOT is the country recruiting the explorer.

on_extend_regency.doc: ROOT is the country extending its regency.

on_flagship_captured.doc: ROOT is the country capturing the flagship; FROM is the country losing it.

on_flagship_destroyed.doc: ROOT is the country destroying the flagship; FROM is the country losing it.

on_force_conversion.doc: ROOT is the converted country; FROM is the country forcing the conversion. This can come from a religious peace or an enforce-religion interaction.

on_gain_great_power_status.doc: ROOT is the country gaining great-power status.

on_general_recruited.doc: ROOT is the country recruiting the general.

on_golden_bull_enacted.doc: THIS/ROOT is the Curia controller enacting the Golden Bull.

on_government_change.doc: This action fires when a non-native country changes government type.

on_great_project_constructed.doc: ROOT is the great-project province; FROM is its owner. The action fires after construction finishes.

on_harmonized_buddhism.doc: This action is used for Theravada harmonization.

on_harmonized_pagan.doc: This action is used for pagan harmonization.

on_heir_death.doc: ROOT is the country whose heir died.

on_heir_needed_theocracy.doc: This action fires when a theocracy has no heir.

on_holy_order_established.doc: ROOT is the country establishing the holy order; its first province in the state is set.

on_hre_defense.doc: This action fires when the Emperor comes to the defense of an HRE member.

on_hre_member_annexed.doc: This action fires when an HRE member is annexed by a non-HRE country.

on_hre_member_false_religion.doc: This action fires when an HRE prince converts to a religion other than the Emperor's.

on_hre_member_true_religion.doc: This action fires when an HRE prince converts to the Emperor's religion.

on_hre_non_defense.doc: This action fires when the Emperor does not come to the defense of an HRE member.

on_hre_province_reconquest.doc: ROOT is the HRE province reconquered by an HRE member in a peace treaty.

on_hre_released_vassal.doc: This action fires when an HRE member is released from non-HRE vassalage.

on_hre_transfered_vassal.doc: This action fires when an HRE member becomes a vassal of the Emperor instead of a non-HRE country.

on_hre_wins_defensive_war.doc: This action fires when the Emperor wins an HRE defensive war.

on_integrate.doc: This action fires after a nation is integrated following a union.

on_janissaries_raised.doc: THIS/ROOT is the province where the Janissaries are raised.

on_leader_recruited.doc: ROOT is the country recruiting the leader.

on_loan_repaid.doc: THIS/ROOT is the country repaying the loan.

on_lose_great_power_status.doc: ROOT is the country losing great-power status.

on_main_war_lost.doc: ROOT is the losing country; FROM is the winning country.

on_main_war_won.doc: ROOT is the winning country; FROM is the losing country.

on_mandate_of_heaven_gained.doc: ROOT is the new Emperor of China; FROM is the old Emperor.

on_mandate_of_heaven_lost.doc: ROOT is the old Emperor of China; FROM is the new Emperor.

on_mercenary_recruited.doc: ROOT is the mercenary company; THIS is the recruiting province; FROM is the recruiting country.

on_mil_advisor_hired.doc: This action executes after on_advisor_hired for a MIL advisor.

on_mil_development.doc: ROOT is the province where military development changed.

on_mil_tech_taken.doc: This action executes after on_tech_taken for a MIL technology.

on_minority_expelled.doc: ROOT/THIS is the colony receiving the minority; FROM is the home province.

on_monarch_death.doc: ROOT is the country whose monarch died.

on_monthly_pulse.doc: This is the country-scoped monthly random-events pulse.

on_native_change_government.doc: This action fires when a native changes government after completing all advancement groups.

on_naval_barrage.doc: ROOT is the country performing the naval barrage; FROM is the province being barraged.

on_new_heir.doc: ROOT is the country receiving the new heir.

on_new_monarch.doc: ROOT is the country with the new monarch; personal-union junior countries may also trigger this action.

on_new_term_election.doc: ROOT is the country holding the new-term election.

on_overrun.doc: ROOT is the winner; FROM is the loser when a stack is wiped out.

on_parliament_debate_failed.doc: ROOT is the country whose parliament debate failed.

on_parliament_debate_reset.doc: ROOT is the country whose parliament debate was reset.

on_parliament_debate_succeeded.doc: ROOT is the country whose parliament debate succeeded.

on_parliament_seat_given.doc: ROOT is the province receiving a parliament seat.

on_parliament_seat_lost.doc: ROOT is the province losing a parliament seat.

on_peace_actor.doc: ROOT is the country acting in the peace interaction.

on_peace_recipient.doc: ROOT is the country receiving the peace interaction.

on_pillaged_capital.doc: ROOT is the country doing the pillaging; FROM is the country whose capital was pillaged.

on_post_adm_advisor_fired.doc: THIS/ROOT is the country after its ADM advisor is fired or replaced.

on_post_dip_advisor_fired.doc: THIS/ROOT is the country after its DIP advisor is fired or replaced.

on_post_mil_advisor_fired.doc: THIS/ROOT is the country after its MIL advisor is fired or replaced.

on_pre_adm_advisor_fired.doc: THIS/ROOT is the country before its ADM advisor is removed; define a replacement in the post action instead.

on_pre_dip_advisor_fired.doc: THIS/ROOT is the country before its DIP advisor is removed.

on_pre_mil_advisor_fired.doc: THIS/ROOT is the country before its MIL advisor is removed.

on_province_culture_changed.doc: ROOT is the province affected by a general culture conversion through effects.

on_province_culture_converted.doc: ROOT is the province affected by manual culture conversion.

on_province_owner_change.doc: ROOT is the province whose owner changed; FROM is the old owner.

on_province_religion_converted.doc: ROOT is the province whose religion was converted.

on_queen_death.doc: ROOT is the country whose queen died.

on_raid_coast.doc: THIS/ROOT is the raiding country; FROM is the sea province.

on_rebels_break_country.doc: THIS/ROOT is the country broken by rebels.

on_refuse_tribute.doc: ROOT is the country handling the tribute; FROM is its overlord.

on_regent.doc: ROOT is the country with a regent.

on_regiment_recruited.doc: THIS/ROOT is the recruiting province; FROM is the recruiting country.

on_released_hre_member.doc: ROOT is the HRE prince released by the Emperor.

on_religion_change.doc: ROOT is the country whose religion changed.

on_remove_pasha.doc: THIS/ROOT is one province in the state losing the pasha.

on_removed_from_company.doc: ROOT is the trade-company province; FROM is the country doing it.

on_replace_governor.doc: ROOT is the country replacing its governor.

on_revoke_estate_land_ai.doc: ROOT is the province involved in the AI estate-land revocation; gradual revocation and rebel handling are not reliable here.

on_royal_marriage.doc: ROOT is the marriage sender; FROM is the marriage accepter.

on_royal_marriage_broken.doc: ROOT is the original marriage creator; FROM is the marriage accepter.

on_scorch_earth.doc: ROOT is the country scorching earth; FROM is the scorched province.

on_secondary_religion_change.doc: ROOT is the country whose secondary religion changed.

on_separate_war_lost.doc: ROOT is the losing country; FROM is the winning country.

on_separate_war_won.doc: ROOT is the winning country; FROM is the losing country.

on_siege_lost_country.doc: ROOT is the losing country; FROM is the siege location.

on_siege_lost_province.doc: ROOT is the siege location; FROM is the winning country.

on_siege_won_country.doc: ROOT is the winning country; FROM is the siege location.

on_siege_won_province.doc: ROOT is the siege location; FROM is the losing country.

on_startup.doc: ROOT is the country. Prefer a scripted effect for complex startup logic so the on_action remains easy to overview.

on_state_edict_enacted.doc: ROOT is a province of the state where the edict was enacted; FROM is the country that enacted it.

on_state_edict_revoked.doc: ROOT is a province of the state where the edict was revoked; FROM is the country that revoked it.

on_successive_emperor.doc: ROOT is the Emperor from the same dynasty as the previous Emperor.

on_tech_taken.doc: ROOT is the country taking the technology.

on_thri_yearly_pulse.doc: This is the country-scoped three-year random-events pulse.

on_trade_good_changed.doc: ROOT is the province whose trade good changed; FROM is the country triggering the change.

on_transfer_development.doc: ROOT is the country receiving development; FROM is the country it was transferred from. Normal concentration may leave FROM unset.

on_war_ended.doc: ROOT is the winning country; FROM is the losing country when the war ends.

on_war_lost.doc: ROOT is the losing country; FROM is the winning country.

on_war_won.doc: ROOT is the winning country; FROM is the losing country.

on_weak_heir_claim.doc: ROOT is the country whose heir has a weak claim.
